decision: Preserve unrun 0.2.3 and create a fail-fast, invocation-stable 0.2.4 release candidate.
observation: Ruff import classification changed with the invocation working directory because the package had no explicit first-party declaration. Run lint and format from the package root with fail-fast shell behavior before building.
Lint the extracted payload using the same explicit configuration and require exact source/archive equality.
Advance all immutable artifact identities to 0.2.4.
